about: Chart milestones (milestones.py). One entry per event: key, ts (UTC seconds), label (plain, the chart marker text), url (post:<id> for a LabLeak post, tx:<txid> for an on-ledger tx, or null), source (where the time was verified), chart_labels (optional: the marker text on a given chart, when that chart shows a different side of the event), charts (where the marker is drawn: chart ids or group names below; [] lists it in the Milestones table only). Genesis cuts come from segments.json and use cut_charts. Live events (milestones.observe) use live_charts by key, else route_charts for route:<id>, else none. Times verified 2026-10-24 against the forum mirror, /api/notices, on-ledger txs and POAScan's tx index.
